description: This header file defines the interface for HostIf message handling, including enums, function prototypes, and a base class for message handlers used in TR-069 communication within a platform-agnostic IPC framework.

classes.name: msgHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for message handler implementations, including initialization, uninitialization, and message processing methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Pure virtual method for initializing the message handler.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Pure virtual method for uninitializing the message handler.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle get attributes message requests.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle set attributes message requests.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle set message requests.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle get message requests.
